candidates.explanation: For the local file driver, the serialization transform prepends appConfig().frontendDomain (FRONTEND_DOMAIN) to the stored relative path. Local files are served by the backend, so the prefix should be backendDomain (BACKEND_DOMAIN). Because of this, avatar URLs in user responses point at the web app host.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
